note: Hebrew el-hachomesh means "in the belly"; "fifth rib" rests on a mistaken link with chamesh "five".

kjv: who [thought] that I (David) would have given him (the man who reported Saul's death) a reward for his tidings
mine: that was the reward I (David) gave him (the man who reported Saul's death) for his news
note: Hebrew asher letitti-lo besorah is elliptical; it is best read ironically (execution was the "reward" for his news), whereas the KJV supplies "thought" to make it the messenger's expectation.
